mapper.insert: INSERT INTO host_vuln_result ( task_id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at ) VALUES ( 0, #{hostId}, #{ruleId}, #{severity}, #{vulnName}, #{productName}, #{productVersion}, #{suggestion}, #{status}, #{verifyStatus}, #{evidenceJson}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE host_vuln_result SET status = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, host_id, rule_id, severity, vuln_name, product_name, product_version, suggestion, status, verify_status, evidence_json, created_at, updated_at FROM host_vuln_result WHERE host_id = #{hostId} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 ORDER BY CASE LOWER(severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, id DESC

SELECT hvr.id AS result_id, vr.id AS rule_id, vr.product_type, vr.product_name, vr.match_type, vr.affected_version_expr AS version_expression, vr.verify_type, vr.verify_rule FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN vuln_rule vr ON vr.id = hvr.rule_id WHERE hvr.host_id = #{hostId} AND hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' AND hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 AND vr.enabled = 1 ORDER BY hvr.id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS critical_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS high_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS medium_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS low_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 AND rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN rule_id > 0 AND UPPER(verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count FROM host_vuln_result

SELECT h.id AS host_id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status AS host_status, CASE MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) WHEN 4 THEN 'critical' WHEN 3 THEN 'high' WHEN 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN 1 THEN 'low' ELSE 'unknown' END AS highest_severity, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS total_vuln_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'PENDING' AND hvr.rule_id > 0 THEN 1 END) AS pending_rule_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFYING' THEN 1 END) AS verifying_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) AS verified_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN hvr.status = 1 AND UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) AS repair_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(hvr.verify_status) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS ignored_count, MAX(COALESCE(hvr.updated_at, hvr.created_at)) AS latest_scan_time FROM host_vuln_result hvr INNER JOIN hosts h ON h.id = hvr.host_id WHERE hvr.rule_id IS NOT NULL AND hvr.rule_id > 0 GROUP BY h.id, h.hostname, h.ipv4, h.mac_address, h.os_name, h.os_version, h.status HAVING total_vuln_count > 0 ORDER BY MAX(CASE LOWER(hvr.severity) WHEN 'critical' THEN 4 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, pending_count DESC, total_vuln_count DESC, latest_scan_time DESC
